name: Travellers
overview: The Scriptures depict travellers as individuals who often journeyed with great care and hospitality, as seen in Abraham’s attentive service to the three visitors at Mamre. They provided rest and refreshment, such as washing feet and offering bread, before the travellers continued on their way. This passage illustrates the importance of kindness and preparation in the context of travel, highlighting the gracious reception and provision extended to wayfarers.
